items.title: Joe Mares Jr. Interview, 1960-04-08
items.q: Rap and Santo and Emmett Hardy and those fellas were on the boat line also for B. Palmer

ctx.x: Can you remember a little bit of the details of that because we can't talk about it.

Well they tell me what I hear and that Paul of course Paul married a Chicago girl and that particular time he was staying at her mother's home and her brother Tommy Harrison was very friendly with Mike Fritzel and Jacob who owned the Cher Parita Big Night Club in Chicago and owned Fry's Inn before that and Tom told them that New Orleans music was getting to be a big thing around there the original Dixieland had come through and a lot of New Orleans boys Tom Brown and all that came through and they liked the New…
that's what I would ask about her
